UAA AI and Robotics Lab acquisition, Educational Legacy Fund funding, faculty/student training

Public recordings remain useful; an additional task can shape a new recording

boundaries_preserved: Acquisition and training are observed; the reading/programming studies remain planned.
Electrical recording is distinct from interpretation; no thoughts, diagnosis or clinical proof claimed.
New-person testing is conditional editorial methods context, with no allegation about UAA.
No sample size, price, accuracy, completed dataset or completed study result is asserted.
Research choice is an additional collection capability, not a claim that public datasets were useless or students previously lacked research agency.
